pages.text: Fermentation requires a barrel $(item)Warmth of at least 3$() and an internal $(item)Barrel Humidity of at least 25$(). The tobacco must not already be fermented or ruined.

Once the barrel enters Fermenting mode, it needs $(item)48,000 ticks$(), about $(item)2 Minecraft days$(), under continuously valid fermentation conditions. Ordinary fermentation remains $(thing)Fermenting$() even if a piston or Mechanical Press happens to be nearby. $(thing)Pressure Fermenting$() is reserved for specialty processes where pressure is actually required, such as Perique and Cavendish. Pressure by itself does not ferment tobacco. If required fermentation conditions are lost, progress resets.
pages.title: Time

pages.text: Successful fermentation marks the tobacco $(thing)Fermented$() and adds $(item)+7 quality$(), with quality allowed to rise as high as 120. Fermentation happens only once per tobacco batch.
pages.title: Result
Automation Safety
pages.text: While a barrel is actively $(thing)Fermenting$(), automated extraction is locked for Funnels, Chutes, Packagers, and Mechanical Arms. This prevents a normal output line from stealing a batch before its finite fermentation cycle finishes. Manual removal can still deliberately disturb the batch.

Barrel Humidity is an internal reservoir that builds over time. Warm, humid surroundings fill it more quickly. The Spectacles show the environmental warmth/humidity; sneak-right-clicking the barrel also reports Barrel Humidity itself.
pages.title: Humidity Charge
Sealed Process
pages.text: A working Tobacco Barrel does $(bold)not$() emit smoke. Fermentation, pressure fermentation, pressing, stoving, and aging are visually sealed barrel processes. Smoke particles belong to curing racks, campfires, Flue Fireboxes, and Haunted soul-fire curing.
